# TypeTorch

> TypeTorch is a roblox-ts framework and toolchain that updates live Roblox games without restarting servers. A small Luau kernel baked into the place loads each build (a payload of ModuleScripts uploaded as a private Model asset) and hot-swaps server and client code in seconds while players stay. Code uses @typetorch/framework (modules with dependency injection, lifecycle hooks, troves, guarded networking, hot assets, an in-game dev menu); the typetorch CLI builds, uploads, approves, signs (prod) and deploys. roblox-ts only. Early: APIs still change. The packages are on npm (@typetorch/framework, kernel, transformer, cli, dev-server); the template installs them with bun install.

Key facts for agents:
- Never handle secrets (Open Cloud keys, signing key files) and never act on Roblox (deploy, publish, keys, approve): those are user steps. Follow agents/AGENTS.md.
- Every module must be stoppable and restartable: everything in this.trove, no module-level state (persist plain data with this.ctx.persist; per-player maps with this.ctx.playerState), players via onPlayerAdded/observePlayers (replays on every swap), characters via @rbxts/observers with the stop function in the trove, no RemoteEvents (createNetwork), no _G.
- Modules reach each other by constructor injection; elsewhere (methods, plain classes, command handlers) with Dependency<T>() / TypeTorch.module<T>(), from onInit on (never in a constructor, field initializer or module top level). A dependency cycle is broken with Lazy<T> (a field `= Lazy<T>()`, or a constructor parameter with @typetorch/transformer 0.2.1+) or Dependency<T>() in a method.
- The payload holds only Folders and ModuleScripts; entry points are src/server/boot.ts and src/client/boot.ts.
- The template repo decides the toolchain (package.json, tsconfig.json, default.project.json, studio.project.json).
- No GitHub Actions, ever (the owner's rule: supply-chain risk). Never add workflows, actions or hosted CI; builds, cloud tests and deploys run on the user's machine.
- Roles in game: owner (experience creator or group owner, plus members with role "owner") and dev; a legacy "admin" counts as dev.
- Analytics (AnalyticsEngine) and the fleet API are optional and self-hosted; the engine does nothing until a game creates it.
- The cloud test (before every prod deploy) runs onInit/onStart in a headless task against the live game's DataStores, MemoryStores, MessagingService and HTTP, with no players and no place scripts; TypeTorch.channel is "dev" there (so channel-split stores point at dev data) and the AnalyticsEngine sends nothing. workspace:GetAttribute("TypeTorchTest") is true there: guard side effects with it; never wait on place scripts.
- Dev access: typetorch.json members/revoked/devBadgeId reach servers only through `typetorch access push` (ConfigService TypeTorchAccess, universe:write; kernel 0.3.6+). ServerScriptService.LoadStringEnabled stays off in a live game (only remote-claude's run_luau needs it; kernel deploy patches leave it alone; `kernel deploy --loadstring`, CLI 0.7.5+, turns it on for a test place). Kernel 0.3.6+: players are never on an empty baseplate (held until a build runs; peers, the backup build baked by kernel deploy, background retries, moves).
- Health window (kernel 0.3.7+): a server rolls a new build back at 3 errors from it within 30 s, or a failed onStart. A game with noisy errors sets typetorch.json `"health": { "errors": 1-100, "window": 5-300 s, "rollback": true|false, "prod"/"dev": {...} }` (stamped on each build); `"autoRollback": { "failedPct": 1-100 }` sets deploy --wait's threshold (default 20). `doctor` shows both; the dev menu's Server > Status shows the open window.

## Get started

- [README](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/README.md): index, how it works, repositories
- [Fresh setup](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/getting-started/fresh-setup.md): tools, clone the template and bun install (optional local override for unreleased framework/kernel changes), typetorch update, experience and settings, typetorch.json, API key scopes (Luau Execution for the cloud test, DataStore scopes for the shared deploy number; universe:read and legacy-asset:manage can't be granted to API keys), signing keys (offline backup), LoadStringEnabled (off in a live game), kernel publish, first deploy (cloud test, --wait), dev branch, owners and devs (typetorch access push), /tt, rollback
- [Migrate an existing game](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/getting-started/migrate.md): toolchain, boot modules, Flamework/Knit/singletons to modules, the swap-safety rules with before/after code, shutdown (onStop is not a save point: a server closing mid-swap runs none), networking, UI, data, optional analytics, the cloud test runs game code against the live game's stores (channel dev; guard side effects with workspace:GetAttribute("TypeTorchTest")), MessagingService topics (5 + 2 x players per server; TypeTorch uses 4), installing the kernel in a place with content (kernel deploy --place-file patches only the kernel), checklist, pitfalls

## Agents

- [Agent playbook](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/agents/AGENTS.md): detect, plan, toolchain, migrate step by step, local checks, stop at user actions, "What you need to do" list, report template, manual kernel updates by agents
- [Claude Code skill](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/agents/skills/typetorch-migrate/SKILL.md): the playbook's essentials as a skill

## Guides

- [Branches and channels](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/branches-and-channels.md): prod/dev, effective channel, private and reserved servers, owners switch any server in place (Switch, Load here)
- [Deploy and rollback](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/deploy-and-rollback.md): deploy stages, artifact ids, shared #seq, ProtocolHash, approval and proposals, safe deploys (cloud test, health window and its typetorch.json "health" settings, last known good, 15 s boot budget, deploy --wait with resend and automatic rollback at 20% or typetorch.json "autoRollback", deploy reports), rollouts, promote, rollback, deployment log, pins, manual kernel updates
- [Live servers and alerts](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/fleet-and-alerts.md): kernel heartbeats, reports and alerts to a SQLite fleet API (TypeTorchFleet key, typetorch fleet setup), typetorch servers/report/alerts, server lost and stuck, alert codes, webhooks, the in-game roll call, no MemoryStore for fleet data
- [Analytics](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/analytics.md): AnalyticsEngine (server and client, collectors, TTZone zones, first-session recording, never collected), the event format, DuckDB server or Cloudflare Basin, the TypeTorchAnalytics settings key, experiments per player and per server, queries, Mermaid node graphs, bun run report, revenue from server-sent purchases only, 32 experiments per session, nothing sent from the cloud test, privacy and Right to Erasure, a local quick start behind a quick tunnel
- [Prod signing](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/prod-signing.md): Root Key and Fallback Key, typetorch keys init/rotate/resign, key asset, kernel 0.3 rule, bootstrap heads, boot fail-safe, back up and drill (offline key backup, a separate IP-limited asset:write key, a dated rotation drill)
- [Player data](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/player-data.md): the swap-safe pattern with ProfileStore and ProfileService examples (DataHost in the place requires the library and runs its writes as jobs, so a deploy can't cut a load, save or release off; skip the wait in the cloud test), developer product receipts recorded in the profile before PurchaseGranted (ProfileService: MetaTags + MetaTagsLatest), shutdown
- [State with charm](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/state.md): atoms are per generation; server atoms start from persist, charm-sync over a createNetwork leaf with an unknown payload, the client asks for a full state in onStart (after every join and swap), per-player syncers
- [Go-live checklist](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/go-live-checklist.md): moving a game with live players: prepare (keys, a fleet API that stays up, topics), a copy of the game, convert, Studio test, kernel in the copy, a dev-branch soak with live tests (rollback, broken build, data, purchases, kernel undo, key rotation), data check, cut-over, what to do if it goes wrong
- [Hot assets](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/hot-assets.md): TypeTorchAsset, typetorch assets sync, hotAsset(), updating held tools, migrating templates
- [Testing in Studio](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/studio-testing.md): studio.project.json, bun run watch + bun run studio, local payload
- [The dev menu](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/dev-menu.md): Artifact (uptimes, Signing), Modules (Overview, State explorer, Assets), Server (Status, Branch: Switch, Load here, Join), Manage (owners: Players, Servers, Load a build, Bans), Logs (Upload to the paired dev PC), Dex, Network, Claude; /tt commands
- [Runtime API](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/runtime-api.md): TypeTorch.* identity, startInfo, onSwapOut, onUpdatePending, onBranchChanged, persist, playerState, module/tryModule and Dependency<T>(), roles, status, logs, asset
- [Networking](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/networking.md): createNetwork, guards, limits, requests, invokeWithTimeout and per-leaf timeouts (seconds), emit (Flamework predict), Flamework networking names
- [remote-claude](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/remote-claude.md): Claude Code prompted from a dev server; Live/Code modes, deploy approval, screenshots, Toolbox
- [Security model](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/security.md): owners and devs, access push (TypeTorchAccess), what protects prod, accepted risks, keys and tokens, no GitHub Actions, never publish secrets
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/typetorch/docs/blob/main/guides/troubleshooting.md): real errors and fixes (cloud test, --wait, fleet, quick tunnels, analytics, dependency cycles, "isn't constructed yet")
